items.title: John Handy Interview, 1963-11-21
items.q: George Boyd used to play clarinet with him a while.

ctx.x: Remember how many pieces he had? He had six pieces. What's up? Coronet or trumpet was he? Used to play cornet at the time.
Clarinet, trombone? Yeah, clarinet, trombone. George Boyd used to play clarinet with him a while. Did George Boyd come here with him?
Yes. What chord instrument did he have? A banjo, a guitar, a piano, what? No, it's that banjo. Banjo.
